newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TRYGG HANSA SAYS HOME MISSED INTEREST PAYMENT.
newsitem.headline: TRYGG HANSA SAYS HOME MISSED INTEREST PAYMENT.

text.p: Swedish insurance company Trygg-Hansa AB said on Monday U.S. insurance company Home Holdings Inc., formerly majority owned by a Trygg Hansa unit, failed to make its interest payments on a loan due on June 15.
Trygg-Hansa said the conditions of the loan it made to Home Holdings stipulated that Home had 30 days, until July 14, to repay.

"Home Holdings cannot make the payments because the board of the Home Insurance subsidiary voted to delay the decision about a dividend which was necessary to finance the payments," Trygg-Hansa said in a statement.
Trygg-Hansa said Home's exposure to it totalled 354 million crowns, of which 99 million crowns was in shares and 255 million crowns was in loans.
-- Abigail Schmelz, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1003 Monday, 16 June 1997 15:35:11 ENDS nSH1601705
